content_feed.telegram_post: 💰 BUYBACK | VRL Logistics Limited (NSE: VRLLOG) VRL Logistics Limited approves buyback of 87.5 million shares at ₹320 each ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Shares to be bought back: 87,50,000 equity shares - Price per share: ₹320 - Total consideration: ₹28,000 lakh (₹2,80,000,000) - Percentage of equity capital: 5% of paid‑up equity shares - Route: Tender offer, proportionate basis 📌 What happened: ↳ Shareholders approved the buyback via postal ballot; the company will repurchase shares at ₹320 each under the Buy‑Back Regulations. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing

content_feed.telegram_post: ✂️ STOCK_SPLIT | BLS E-Services Limited (NSE: BLSE) BLS E-Services Limited announces 1:2 stock split ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Pre‑split shares: 11,00,00,000 equity shares, face value ₹10 - Post‑split shares: 22,00,00,000 equity shares, face value ₹5 - Authorized capital: ₹110,00,00,000 → ₹110,00,00,000 (unchanged) - Issued & paid‑up capital: ₹90,85,64,850 → ₹90,85,64,850 (unchanged) 📌 What happened: ↳ The company split each equity share into two, reducing face value from ₹10 to ₹5, and credited the new shares under ISIN INE0NLT01028. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing

content_feed.headline: Pace Digitek Secures Rs 1,794 Cr LOI from BSES Rajdhani Power for 57.5 MW BESS
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Order win with LOI disclosed.
content_feed.telegram_post: 📜 #ORDER | Pace Digitek Limited (NSE: PACEDIGITK) Secures Rs 1,794 Cr LOI from BSES Rajdhani Power for 57.5 MW BESS ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - LOI Value: ₹1,794 million - Client: BSES Rajdhani Power Limited - Project Capacity: 57.5 MW / 115 MWh - Model: 12‑year BOOT - Capital Outlay: ₹179.4 crore - Execution Time: 7 months 📌 What happened: ↳ Company received a Letter of Intent for a 57.5 MW BESS project under a 12‑year BOOT model, adding to its utility‑scale BOO/BOOT portfolio. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
